values.note: $24 per single site; the three stock sites with corrals are $30. Same in recreation.gov's 2027 table. One RV per single site; an extra vehicle is charged per night at the campground.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/east-marvine-campground ('Single Site: $24 per night', 'Equestrian Site: $30 per night'; last updated June 6, 2025) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10351998/rates (2026 and 2027: Singlesite 24, EquestrianSinglesite 30) + recreation.gov notice ('One RV per single site ... An extra vehicle will be charged a per-night fee'), read 2026-10-26

hookups.source: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 10351998 (all 10 sites NONELECTRIC, Water Hookup No) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/east-marvine-campground ('There is no potable water available'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: 7 family sites (30-ft back-ins in the catalog) plus 3 pull-through stock sites with corrals, outside the main campground and for stock users only. The trailhead parking areas have plenty of room for trailers.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/east-marvine-campground ('The East Marvine Campground has 7 non-reservable campsites', 'Three campsites with corrals are set aside for stock users only outside the main campground') + campsite catalog for 10351998 (sites 1-7 STANDARD NONELECTRIC, Max Vehicle Length 30, Back-in; 8-10 EQUESTRIAN, 70, Pull-through) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10351998 ('The Marvine parking areas provide plenty of room for trailers and vehicles'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Toilet, trash collection and bear-proof food lockers at each site; no drinking water (livestock can drink from the stream about 400 yards away). Hitchracks in the parking lot.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/east-marvine-campground ('Potable water is not available at this site', 'picnic tables, toilet, fire grates, and trash disposal') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10351998 ('Bear-proof food lockers are provided at each site', 'Hitchracks are available in the parking lot'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: The Forest Service lists the 7 family sites as non-reservable, and recreation.gov's 2027 table is a first-come season only (May 13 - Oct 31, 2027). The one exception seen: in the 2026 fall hunting season (Sept 29 - Nov 1) recreation.gov took bookings for site 1 and the three stock sites. A site must be occupied the first night.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/east-marvine-campground ('7 non-reservable campsites') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10351998/rates (2026 'Peak Season' 2026-09-29 to 11-01; 2027 'First-come, First-served Season' 2027-05-13 to 10-31) + recreation.gov availability (Oct 2026: sites 1, 8, 9, 10 Available/Reserved, 2-7 Not Reservable; Jun 2027: every site Not Reservable), read 2026-10-26

note: Trailhead campground at 8,200 ft in a conifer-and-aspen grove at the East Marvine and Marvine trailheads into the Flat Tops Wilderness, 35 mi east of Meeker via Rio Blanco CR 8 and CR 12 (Blanco RD, White River NF). Corral sites for stock users sit outside the main campground; the creek is about 400 yards away. Cattle may graze in the area. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $24 (2026, 2027), no hookups, 10 sites. It is a family campground with three stock sites set apart, not the horse camp. Changed booking reservable true -> false with fcfs always (FS: '7 non-reservable campsites'; rec.gov 2027 is a first-come season; only a fall-2026 hunting-season exception for site 1). Added 30-ft max (catalog), back-in, no drinking water. Note: dropped 'Reservable online' (wrong) and 'along the Marvine Creek' (the stream is ~400 yd away). The Marvine water alert concerns the separate Marvine Campground's well; East Marvine has no water anyway. No season statement found (the FS page points to a 'Developed Campgrounds' list that gives no dates).
flags: Entry phone is empty. Blanco Ranger District (970) 878-4039 (fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/offices; also recreation.gov's facility phone). Concessionaire American Land and Leisure: 801-226-3564 (recreation.gov customer service).
Access is 28 mi on Rio Blanco CR 8 then 6 mi on CR 12 to the trailhead; neither page describes the road surface or gives any 4WD/high-clearance or RV-length warning.
Agency page for the website if wanted: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/east-marvine-campground (website is the recreation.gov listing).
